fact: The Annuaire statistique 2024 (15th edition, December 2025) publishes tables for 2019-2024 drawn from administrative sources of the sector ministries: school returns (MEMP annuaires statistiques, MESTFP annuaires statistiques, SIPAGeS, MESRS), health facility reports (MS/DPAF annuaires des statistiques sanitaires, editions 2021-2023), public service records (DPAF/MTFP 2024), road transport records (MIT/CNSR, MTPT annuaire des transports terrestres), utility records (SBEE, SONEB) and meteorological records (METEO-BENIN), alongside INStaD's own prices and national accounts; the 2022 edition (December 2023) is the previous one.
title: Annuaire statistique 2024
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie (INStaD)
